description: Index a value in a list's items, to find items by it (alias), order, filter or search by it, or hide it from tokens (guard). The index is built in the background: until its buildStatus is ready, anything that uses it fails with INDEX_BUILDING. With wait: true this polls until it's built, at 1 metered request per poll (the result says how many). 1 request, plus the polls.

alias.description: Items can be found by this value instead of their id. Values must be unique and at most 1024 characters; one alias index per list

filtering.description: Items can be filtered by it

guard.description: Hide the value at pointer from token reads (only an identity that owns an item can read it). Not combinable with the other flags

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

pathName.description: The name used to filter and order by it, e.g. "score". Unique in the list, and stored lowercase

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the indexed value in each item's data, e.g. /score

sorting.description: Items can be ordered by it

tags.description: Tags (at most 20). Replaces the existing tags

wait.description: Wait (up to 30 seconds) for the build to finish, polling with metered requests

name: create_index
title: Create an index
